text: Okay, well let's go and do some more edits to the game. All right, so back we go. Now it already gave us a heads up display, the score and the health and the ammo, which is more than I asked for. So let's ask for something it hasn't done. We'll say, please add a minimap in the corner so I can see where the bot is, and also make the difficulty harder. Let's see what it makes of this. I'll let it do its planning, and its thinking. We will go through in more detail at some point about planning, and then executing on these kinds of ideas. And I will see you in a second when it's finished its work.
